card.name: Verb before a fixed label phrase
card.fires_on: The word "is" right after "the number" in the suicide-trial sentence, and "to" after "transaminase levels returned". Both sit in repeated label sentences.

modes.label: Suicide trial sentence
modes.description: "is" after "the number" in the sentence saying the number of suicides is too small to allow a conclusion.
modes.example: There were four suicides in drug-treated patients in the trials and none in placebo-treated patients, but the number<< is>> too small to allow any conclusion about drug

modes.label: Transaminase recovery
modes.description: "to" after "returned" in a sentence about liver enzyme levels going back to normal.
modes.example: Upon dose reduction, drug interruption, or discontinuation, transaminase levels returned<< to>> or near pretreatment levels without sequelae

card.plain: It fires on a small linking word inside two stock label sentences, one about suicides in trials and one about liver enzymes returning to normal.
